review_evidence: Declaration grep over 310 listed files: 305 files have at least one line-start declaration; 5 have zero.
Read Complexitylib/Circuits/AC0.lean completely: 11 public imports of AC0 submodules plus a long docstring describing the AC0 class and switching surface; no declarations.
Read Complexitylib/Circuits/AC0/Defs.lean completely: 4 Mathlib public imports plus a docstring saying Complexity.AC0 moved to DepthClasses.Defs; compatibility import path, no declarations.
Read Complexitylib/Circuits/Encoding/Internal.lean completely: 4 public imports (Codec, Fragment, Semantics, ToCircuit) plus an aggregation docstring.
Read Complexitylib/Circuits/Encoding/Machine/Core/Internal.lean completely: 16 public imports of evaluator execution internals plus an aggregation docstring.
Read Complexitylib/Circuits/Internal/Bridge.lean completely: 2 public imports (ShannonBridge, SchnorrBridge) plus a docstring.
Grep for line-start open/notation/attribute/set_option/#guard/#eval/#check matched 50 of the 310 files; none of the 5 import-only files matched.
No verified deployed auxiliary channel for import-only modules was established, so per FILTER-007 the 5 aggregators stay primary-eligible.
summary: Surveyed all 310 listed Lean files under Complexitylib/Circuits (445 to 147843 bytes; all in the main source tree, no scripts, tests, generated, or vendored files). A line-start declaration grep (theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|opaque, with modifiers and attributes) found declarations in 305 files. The 5 zero-declaration files were read completely: each holds only a module header, public imports, and a module docstring, so they are pure import aggregators that FILTER-007 keeps primary-eligible (ranked lower, not excluded). All files are retained.
